ModMetaData.name: Quadrunner
ModMetaData.author: Joshtrazyn
ModMetaData.description:
Sci-fi robot dogs dispatched from a powered stable: Quadrunners haul, clean, supply construction and carry riders; Medirunners rescue the downed; Combatdogs defend the colony and upgrade through four tiers.
Research Microelectronics, build a stable under Misc, and assemble dogs through its bills. Charge and repair at the stable, maintain field batteries and repair kits, and keep wrecks for rebuilding.
RimWorld 1.6, Core + Harmony only. No DLC required; DLC-enabled configurations are unverified.
Before removing the mod, load the colony and use Mod settings → Quadrunner → Prepare save for removing Quadrunner. It creates a backup and a separate cleaned save. Quit without saving again, disable the mod, then load the cleaned save.
